name: Fate Finder
source:
Fate Finder is a romantic mystery visual novel game that immerses players into the role of a private investigator who runs a moderately successful business out of their apartment due to their special ability to see the red string of fate between everyone except herself. Fate Finder is based on folklore in which there is a red string of fate between soulmates. 

Players take on the role of Moira Inoue, a private investigator who runs the business “Fate Finder.” Clients come to Moira in search of answers as to who is their soulmate or why their supposed twin flame is acting suspiciously.

Moira wonders why she cannot see her own red string of fate, maybe the truth would hurt more than it would comfort. Perhaps, the reason she cannot see her red string is that it is nonexistent. By completing the cases, players unlock more of Moira’s story and options to explore and discover the truth of whether she has a soulmate of her own or not.

[From [url=https://vc-creative-endeavors.itch.io/fate-finder]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Fate Finder》是一款浪漫悬疑视觉小说游戏，玩家将扮演一名私家侦探的角色，她在自己的公寓里经营着一家相当成功的企业，因为他们有特殊的能力可以看到除了她自己之外的每个人之间的命运红线。《命运寻找者》取材于民间传说，灵魂伴侣之间有一条命运的红线。

玩家扮演井上莫伊拉（Moira Inoue）的角色，她是一名私家侦探，经营着“命运寻找者”公司。客户来到莫伊拉寻求答案，以了解谁是他们的灵魂伴侣，或者为什么他们所谓的双胞胎火焰行为可疑。

莫伊拉想知道为什么她看不到自己的命运红线，也许真相会带来更多的伤害，而不是安慰。也许，她看不到自己的红绳，是因为它不存在。通过完成案件，玩家可以解锁更多莫伊拉的故事和选项，以探索和发现她是否拥有自己的灵魂伴侣的真相。

[来自[url=https://vc-creative-endeavors.itch.io/fate-finder]Itch.io[/url]]
